Class JSONUtils

public without sharing class JSONUtils

Utility class for handling JSON operations in Salesforce. Provides methods for parsing, traversing, and manipulating JSON data structures including support for nested paths, array notation, and type-safe value extraction. Includes helper classes for JSON records, SObject mapping, and field transformations.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
    04/22/2017

Version:
    2.40


Change Log

  • 04/22/2017 - v1.00 - Initial version.
  • 05/07/2017 - v1.10 - Make sure given path and tag exist in JSON, otherwise returning null.
  • 05/21/2017 - v1.20 - Nest the JSON fields as a new object with a higher hierarchy level.
  • 04/19/2021 - v1.30 - JSONRecord: New methods put(), serialize() so now this class could be used to create JSON files.
  • 09/11/2021 - v1.40 - Class MappingField moved from main class IntegrationDataTools.
  • 06/22/2025 - v2.00 - API version updated to 64.0. Class renamed to JSONUtils. Logic improved. New methods: getAsInteger(), getAsLong(), getAsObject().
  • 06/26/2025 - v2.01 - Fix bug where containsField() and get() were not checking for null values in JSON map
  • 07/12/2025 - v2.10 - Add support for array notation (e.g., "token[0]/nextToken").
  • 08/17/2025 - v2.20 - containsField(): If the tokenPath ends with an array notation, remove the array index.
  • 08/17/2025 - v2.30 - get(): If the tokenPath ends with an array notation (e.g., "token[0]"), get the array element.
  • 11/01/2025 - v2.40 - New method deserializeAsyncOptions() to parse AsyncOptions from JSON.
  • 11/08/2025 - v2.41 - Improve logic for method JSONRecord.getAsRecord(). Method getDatetime() moved to DateUtils class.

private static JSONUtils.IsBoolean getBoolean(String strBoolean)

Converts a string value to an IsBoolean enum value. Recognizes common string representations of boolean values in a case-insensitive manner.

Parameters:
    strBoolean – String value to convert. Accepts:
  • Truthy values: '1', 'true', 'yes', 'y'
  • Falsy values: '0', 'false', 'no', 'n'
  • All other values return NA

Returns:
    IsBoolean.Yes for truthy values, IsBoolean.No for falsy values, IsBoolean.NA otherwise.
